name: sim-agentation
description: Annotate a running iOS simulator in the browser and hand each note to your agent: the sim-agentation MCP server, plus skills for working through annotations and adding the SimAgentationPlus SDK.

args: for b in "$SIM_AGENTATION_BIN" "$(command -v sim-agentation)" /opt/homebrew/bin/sim-agentation /usr/local/bin/sim-agentation; do [ -n "$b" ] && [ -x "$b" ] && exec "$b" mcp; done; echo 'sim-agentation is not installed: brew install lcandy2/tap/sim-agentation' >&2; exit 1
